title: Суд над Лавровым  (The Trial of Lavrov)

scenes.title: The Chef's Proposal and Max's Divorce
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov celebrates his engagement to Elena Pavlovna and invites Max to drink after learning about Max's divorce from Vika.

scenes.title: Senya Under Marina's Thumb
scenes.summary: Fedya mocks Senya for fearing his wife Marina, and Senya imagines what would happen if he tried to stand up to her at home.

scenes.title: Macaroni and a Rolling Pin
scenes.summary: Senya's fantasy of bossing his wife around at dinner backfires spectacularly when she retaliates with a pan of pasta.

scenes.title: Kostya's Gladiator Dream
scenes.summary: Kostya explains to Nastya that he only elbowed her in his sleep because he was dreaming about fighting a lion as a gladiator.

scenes.title: Shark or Crocodile?
scenes.summary: After telling Nastya a romantic story to make her happy, Kostya privately imagines a carefree bachelor life.

scenes.title: Lyova's Jealousy Over Gulya
scenes.summary: Lyova imagines giving Gulya another teddy bear and lashing out when Fedya and Senya admire her in the corridor.

scenes.title: People Disappearing in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: In Lyova's daydream, he eliminates Kostya as a potential rival, and Ainura decides to take Gulya back home for safety.

scenes.title: A Toast to the Chef and Lyova
scenes.summary: Gulya forgives Lyova in his daydream, and Lyova snaps back to reality to raise a glass to Chef Barinov.

scenes.title: Song of a Broken Heart
scenes.summary: Katya asks Chef Barinov what he would do if Elena said no, and he imagines singing a dramatic ballad about lost love.

scenes.title: Path to the Big Stage
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov imagines Elena returning to him after hearing his concert, but Senya doubts how realistic that is for show business.

scenes.title: The Idea of a Trial for Infidelity
scenes.summary: The cooks debate whether Max deserves a divorce for kissing Sasha, and Katya wishes infidelity were tried in a real court.

scenes.title: Beginning the Trial of Lavrov
scenes.summary: Judge Barinov presides over Max's imaginary infidelity trial as Vika recounts what happened in the storage room during Sasha's wedding.

scenes.title: A Kiss or a Speck in the Eye?
scenes.summary: Kostya claims a kiss is not cheating until Nastya teaches him a lesson, so he suggests Sasha was only removing a speck from Max's eye.

scenes.title: The Bribed Witness Arseniy
scenes.summary: Kostya presents a faulty belt as evidence and calls Senya as a bribed defense witness, only for Nastya to call Senya right back.

scenes.title: Calling the Best Friend
scenes.summary: Senya testifies against Max for the prosecution, so Kostya takes the witness stand himself as Max's best friend.

scenes.title: Interrogation Under Oath
scenes.summary: Prosecutor Nastya pressures Kostya on the witness stand until he admits that Max is a womanizer who used to date Sasha.

scenes.title: Where Is Witness Kristina?
scenes.summary: Max reminds Kostya that he once rejected Kristina Nagiyev, so Kostya calls her as a witness, expecting her to magically appear.

scenes.title: The Twin Brother and the Verdict
scenes.summary: Kostya brings in Timur pretending to be Max's twin brother Vlad, but Judge Barinov scares Timur off and finds Max guilty.

scenes.title: If a Woman Hates You
scenes.summary: Vika overhears Max celebrating with the cooks and glares at him, leading Chef Barinov to remind Max that hatred means she still cares.
